# EXN Lube

> EXN Lube is a Malaysian lubricant brand owned by EXN Lube Marketing Sdn. Bhd. (reg. 201201003247 (976772-K)), founded in 2015 in Petaling Jaya, Selangor. It makes engine oils for cars, motorcycles and heavy duty diesels, industrial and marine lubricants, grease, ATF/CVT fluids and the +Care car care series, sold through 700+ workshops and retailers in Malaysia and exported to 12 markets. Slogan: The Lubricant Expert.

## Key facts
- Company: EXN Lube Marketing Sdn. Bhd., registration 201201003247 (976772-K)
- Founded: 2015; Founder and CEO: Marc Ee
- Head office: Lot W3A06-A07, Level 3A, Metropolitan Square, Jalan PJU 8/1, Damansara Perdana, 47820 Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia
- Phone: +60 3-7733 8313; fax +60 3-7733 6208; email marketing@exnlube.com
- Network: 700+ workshops, spare parts shops and retailers in Malaysia
- Export markets: South Korea, Brunei, Vietnam, China, Hong Kong, Macau, Tonga, Cambodia, Singapore, Thailand, Laos, United Arab Emirates
- Motorsport: Malaysia Speed Festival partner every year since 2017
- Technology: Molytech (buckyball nano particles that act like ball bearings to cut friction, heat and drag)
- Singapore distributor: KohDen International Pte Ltd, 7 Kaki Bukit Road 1 #01-15, Singapore 415937, +65 6966 6565

## Engine oils
- EXN Extentios Hybrid 0W-16: API SP; Fully synthetic; 4L
- EXN Extentios Molyracing 0W-20: API SN/CF, ACEA A5/B5; Fully synthetic (PAO and ester); 4L
- EXN Extentios Molyracing 5W-30: API SN/CF, ACEA A3/B4, C3; Fully synthetic (PAO and ester); 4L
- EXN Extentios Molyracing 5W-40: API SN/CF, ACEA A3/B4, C3; Fully synthetic (PAO and ester); 4L
- EXN Extentios Molyracing 5W-50: API SN/CF, ACEA A3/B4, C3; Fully synthetic (PAO and ester); 1L
- EXN Carios Molytech Nano 5W-30: API SN/CF, ACEA A3/B4; Molytech nano formula; 4L
- EXN Carios Molytech Nano 10W-40: API SN/CF, ACEA A3/B4; Molytech nano formula; 4L
